about: Constitution Principle VII. Two halves, for two different reasons.

terms: plaintext, the tracked-entity vocabulary. Ordinary English with nothing to conceal, so the documents whose subject is the prohibition may name it; those are listed in plaintextExemptPaths and are reviewed with this file.
hashedTerms: salted SHA-256 of customer, project and bid material, which must appear nowhere at all and therefore cannot be written here either. No exemption applies to these.
Add a hashed term with: pnpm exec tsx scripts/gates/check-vocabulary.ts --hash "<term>"
The ordinary navigational word for the path a vessel has travelled is deliberately absent from both halves.

derivedArtefactPaths are excluded from both halves: they are build outputs, not writing. Gate G-01 regenerates each of them from digest-verified public inputs and fails on any byte difference, so a hand-written file placed among them fails that gate rather than hiding from this one.
